say:2:1310306001:1.source_cn: 主、主人……这里到底发生了什么？！

say:3:1310306002:1.text: The inn's been completely ransacked... did someone rob the place? Are all the staff... dead?
say:3:1310306002:1.source_cn: 旅店里被弄得乱七八糟的，像是被人抢劫了一样……这些店员...

say:4:1310306003:1.text: We need to check on them quickly. Maybe there are some survivors.
say:4:1310306003:1.source_cn: 我们得赶紧检查一下这些店员，或许还能救活一些幸运儿……

say:5:1310306004:1.text: Look at that body over there... those bunny ears... they look kind of familiar.
say:5:1310306004:1.source_cn: 主人，你看那边躺着的那具尸体……那双兔子耳朵……看起来...
say:5:1310306004:1.male: Look at that body over there... those bunny ears... they look kind of familiar.
say:5:1310306004:1.female: Look at that body over there... those bunny ears... they look kind of familiar.
